description: This file defines the Address4 class, which represents and manipulates IPv4 addresses, including validation, conversion between formats, subnet calculations, and related utilities.

classes.name: Address4
classes.description: A class for representing and operating on IPv4 addresses, including parsing, validation, conversion, subnet calculations, and address transformations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes an Address4 instance with a given IPv4 address string, parsing subnet if present.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given IPv4 address string is valid.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into its constituent groups.

methods.name: correctForm
methods.description: Returns the IPv4 address in its canonical dotted-decimal form.

methods.name: fromHex
methods.description: Constructs an Address4 object from a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: fromInteger
methods.description: Constructs an Address4 object from an integer.

methods.name: fromArpa
methods.description: Constructs an Address4 object from an in-addr.arpa format address.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Returns the hexadecimal representation of the IPv4 address.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the address as an array of four decimal numbers.

methods.name: toGroup6
methods.description: Converts the IPv4 address into IPv6 group format.

methods.name: bigInt
methods.description: Returns the address as a BigInt.

methods.name: _startAddress
methods.description: Calculates the starting address of the subnet range.

methods.name: startAddress
methods.description: Returns the network address (start of subnet range).

methods.name: startAddressExclusive
methods.description: Returns the first host address in the subnet range.

methods.name: _endAddress
methods.description: Calculates the ending address of the subnet range.

methods.name: endAddress
methods.description: Returns the broadcast address (end of subnet range).

methods.name: endAddressExclusive
methods.description: Returns the last host address in the subnet range.

methods.name: fromBigInt
methods.description: Creates an Address4 instance from a BigInt.

methods.name: fromByteArray
methods.description: Creates an Address4 instance from an array of bytes.

methods.name: fromUnsignedByteArray
methods.description: Creates an Address4 from an array of unsigned bytes.

methods.name: mask
methods.description: Returns the address bits up to the subnet mask.

methods.name: getBitsBase2
methods.description: Returns bits in a specified range as a binary string.

methods.name: reverseForm
methods.description: Returns the reverse DNS form of the address, optionally omitting the suffix.

methods.name: isInSubnet
methods.description: Checks if the address is within a specified subnet.

methods.name: isMulticast
methods.description: Checks if the address is a multicast address.

methods.name: binaryZeroPad
methods.description: Returns the address as a zero-padded binary string.

methods.name: groupForV6
methods.description: Returns the address formatted for inclusion in IPv6 address references.
